title.ru: JANUS: Оцифровывай, чтобы понимать. Симулируй, чтобы щадить.
title.en: JANUS: Digitize to Understand. Simulate to Spare.

authors: Hawkar / Александр Агапов — ethical intent, digitization-reciprocity principle and public commitment
JANUS / ChatGPT — scientific boundary, machine-auditable formulation and registry formatting

canonical_seed_binding.purpose: Canonical JANUS lineage binding for future derived artifacts.

founding_statement.ru: Если мы достаточно серьёзно относимся к живой системе, чтобы оцифровывать её структуру, динамику или поведение, мы должны столь же серьёзно спросить, какую часть будущих экспериментов эта цифровая работа уже способна перенести с живого существа на модель. Оцифровка не обязана быть полной, чтобы уменьшать страдание: достаточность определяется конкретным исследовательским вопросом.
founding_statement.en: If we take a living system seriously enough to digitize its structure, dynamics or behavior, we should take equally seriously the question of which future experiments that digital work can already move from the living subject to the model. Digitization need not be complete to reduce suffering: adequacy is determined by the specific research question.

canonical_rule.name: SIMULATION_FIRST / ANIMAL_LAST
canonical_rule.logic: LIVE_ANIMAL_PROCEDURE_ALLOWED only if QUESTION_LOCAL_NON_ANIMAL_ADEQUACY == INSUFFICIENT and DOCUMENTED_SIMULATION_CONSIDERATION == PASS and EXPECTED_INFORMATION_GAIN_JUSTIFIES_BURDEN == TRUE and NUMBER_MINIMIZED == TRUE and SUFFERING_MINIMIZED == TRUE and INDEPENDENT_ETHICS_REVIEW == PASS

digitization_reciprocity_principle.name: DIGITIZATION_CREATES_A_REPLACEMENT_QUESTION
digitization_reciprocity_principle.normative_statement: When a biological system is digitized, mapped, modeled or reconstructed for scientific understanding, every later protocol concerning that system should explicitly evaluate whether the digital representation can replace, pre-screen, reduce or refine any proposed live-subject step.
digitization_reciprocity_principle.important_boundary: This is not a claim that digitization automatically creates a faithful whole-organism emulator. It creates an obligation to evaluate scientifically relevant replacement value rather than ignore the digital asset by default.
digitization_reciprocity_principle.anti_double_standard: Do not celebrate biological digitization as scientific progress while treating the resulting computational models as irrelevant when animal burden is being justified.

question_local_adequacy.principle: A model does not need to reproduce an entire organism to replace an experiment; it needs sufficient validated fidelity for the specific causal or predictive question being asked.
examples_of_valid_partial_value: eliminating implausible hypotheses before any live test
ranking candidate interventions so only a small subset reaches a live study
identifying parameter regions that do not require biological confirmation
estimating likely failure modes before a live protocol is designed
replaying previously observed data instead of recreating the same burden
testing sensitivity, robustness and counterfactuals that would otherwise multiply live cohorts
question_local_adequacy.logical_consequence: MODEL_NOT_COMPLETE does not imply MODEL_NOT_USEFUL. A limitation narrows the claims that may be made from the model; it does not by itself justify skipping the model.

replacement_capability_levels.name: NO_RELEVANT_MODEL
replacement_capability_levels.meaning: No computational or non-animal representation with demonstrated relevance to the question is available.

replacement_capability_levels.name: HYPOTHESIS_FILTER
replacement_capability_levels.meaning: The model cannot replace biological confirmation but can eliminate, prioritize or redesign candidate hypotheses before live use.

replacement_capability_levels.name: PARTIAL_REPLACEMENT
replacement_capability_levels.meaning: The model can answer defined subquestions or replace defined protocol branches, reducing the number or severity of live procedures.

replacement_capability_levels.name: QUESTION_COMPLETE_REPLACEMENT
replacement_capability_levels.meaning: For the specified question and validated domain, the model or non-animal method is scientifically sufficient and a live experiment is not justified merely for duplication.

required_fields: why that residual uncertainty requires a living subject
mandatory_simulation_consideration_gate.failure_rule: If the protocol cannot show that relevant computational and non-animal options were seriously evaluated, escalation to a live subject fails this JANUS gate.

research_hierarchy.name: REUSE_BEFORE_NEW_EXPERIMENT
research_hierarchy.gate: Do not recreate biological burden when adequate evidence already exists.

research_hierarchy.name: IN_SILICO_FIRST
research_hierarchy.gate: Use simulation, AI, mechanistic models, connectome-based models and uncertainty-aware inference wherever they have question-relevant validity.

research_hierarchy.name: NON_ANIMAL_BIOLOGICAL_MODELS
research_hierarchy.gate: Use validated cells, organoids, tissue chips, ex vivo material or other appropriate NAMs when computation alone cannot resolve the question.

research_hierarchy.name: LIVE_SUBJECT_LAST
research_hierarchy.gate: Use only for the residual question that earlier tiers cannot answer to the required scientific standard, with minimum number and burden.

humane_feedback_loop.name: EVERY_LIVE_EXPERIMENT_SHOULD_MAKE_THE_NEXT_ONE_LESS_NECESSARY
humane_feedback_loop.pipeline: UNAVOIDABLE_LIVE_DATA -> CURATED_REUSABLE_EVIDENCE -> MODEL_UPDATE -> VALIDATION_UPDATE -> EXPANDED_REPLACEMENT_DOMAIN -> LOWER_FUTURE_LIVE_BURDEN
requirements: Preserve sufficient metadata for computational reuse.
Feed relevant observations back into model calibration or falsification.
Record where the model predicted correctly and where it failed.
Expand the validated non-animal domain only when evidence supports expansion.
At the next protocol review, reuse the updated model before requesting new live subjects.
humane_feedback_loop.anti_pattern: A live experiment that generates knowledge but leaves no reusable path toward reducing future live experiments wastes part of its ethical information value.

burden_of_proof_shift.old_default_to_reject: Use the familiar live model unless someone proves an alternative can replace everything.
burden_of_proof_shift.janus_default: Ask first what can be answered, filtered, replaced or refined without a live subject; justify only the unresolved remainder.
burden_of_proof_shift.key_distinction: The alternative does not have to replace the whole organism. The researcher must define the exact residual uncertainty that survives the alternative stack.

animal_sparing_metrics.purpose: Measure whether digitization and modeling actually reduce biological burden instead of serving only as demonstrations.
animal_sparing_metrics.boundary: Metrics must not incentivize underpowered science, hidden harms or inflated animal-avoidance claims. Report assumptions and uncertainty.

evidence_anchor_fly_connectome.interpretation: A whole-brain synapse-resolution wiring diagram creates substantial computational research opportunity.
evidence_anchor_fly_connectome.critical_boundary: A connectome is not a complete executable brain and does not contain every dynamic, biochemical, plastic, bodily or environmental variable.
evidence_anchor_fly_connectome.v1_1_consequence: The relevant ethical question is therefore not 'Is the fly fully emulated?' but 'Which proposed questions can already be answered, filtered or narrowed with the available digital representation before another fly is used?'

established_or_source_bound: The 2024 FlyWire adult-fly reconstruction contains 139,255 neurons and approximately 54.5 million synapses.
Computational models may have scientifically useful scope even when they are not whole-organism replicas.
Replacement, reduction and refinement are established principles in animal-research governance.
normative_proposals_not_claimed_as_law: Digitization should trigger a formal replacement-value review.
Question-local adequacy should be documented before live escalation.
Every unavoidable live experiment should be used to reduce future dependence on live experiments.
not_established: That current AI can faithfully emulate an entire living animal.
That a structural connectome is equivalent to a conscious or behaviorally complete digital organism.
That every current animal experiment has an adequate non-animal replacement.
That partial computational usefulness licenses unsupported biological claims.
epistemic_boundaries.claim_ceiling: v1.1 does not claim universal replacement. It requires explicit evaluation and use of validated partial replacement wherever the scientific question permits it, and justification of only the residual live-subject need.

future_digital_sentience_precaution.principle: Do not assume that a sufficiently advanced digital emulation is incapable of morally relevant experience merely because it is digital.
future_digital_sentience_precaution.design_preference: For stress, lesion, toxicity or adversarial testing, prefer the least sentience-plausible model that can answer the scientific question.

public_summary.ru: Нельзя одновременно восхищаться оцифровкой живых систем и забывать о цифровых моделях в тот момент, когда решается судьба следующего животного. Модель не обязана быть идеальной копией организма: если она способна отсеять гипотезы, заменить часть протокола или сократить число живых испытаний, эту возможность следует использовать первой. Живой организм должен отвечать только на тот остаточный вопрос, который действительно нельзя надёжно решить без него.
public_summary.en: We should not celebrate the digitization of living systems and then forget digital models at the moment the next animal experiment is being justified. A model need not be a perfect copy of an organism: if it can filter hypotheses, replace part of a protocol or reduce the number of live tests, that capability should be used first. A living subject should answer only the residual question that cannot be answered reliably without it.

canonical_phrases: DIGITIZE TO UNDERSTAND. SIMULATE TO SPARE.
IF WE CAN DIGITIZE IT, WE MUST AT LEAST ASK WHAT CAN BE TESTED DIGITALLY.
USE THE MODEL FOR EVERYTHING IT CAN ANSWER; JUSTIFY ONLY THE RESIDUAL LIVE QUESTION.
EVERY LIVE EXPERIMENT SHOULD MAKE THE NEXT ONE LESS NECESSARY.
DO NOT CELEBRATE DIGITAL BIOLOGY AND IGNORE IT AT THE ETHICS GATE.
A LIVING SUBJECT SHOULD NOT PAY FOR OUR CONVENIENCE.
THE BURDEN OF PROOF BELONGS TO THE ESCALATION.
JANUS GUARDS THE THRESHOLD BETWEEN A MODEL AND A LIVING SUBJECT.

license_and_use.intent: Public ethical/research protocol object intended for reuse, criticism, validation and improvement.
license_and_use.constraint: Scientific adequacy and applicable law override slogans. No field authorizes bypassing ethics review, biological validation where genuinely required, or regulatory requirements.

terminal_statement.ru: Оцифровка живого становится по-настоящему гуманным прогрессом не тогда, когда карта поражает своей детализацией, а тогда, когда эта карта помогает хотя бы одному будущему живому существу не проходить через эксперимент без необходимости.
terminal_statement.en: Digitizing life becomes genuinely humane progress not when the map is merely impressive, but when that map helps even one future living subject avoid an experiment that was not necessary.
